title: Encounter, Autonomy, Score/Timing, Loadout & Skill-Resolution Runtime

selection_basis.strict_order: GPR-01 → GPR-03 → GPR-05 → GPR-06 → GPR-07 → GPR-08 → GPR-09 → GPR-10 → GPR-12 → GPR-16
selection_basis.parallel_lanes: MRCS-19 and OARC-05 remain independently selected_not_started.

objective: Implement bounded encounter/autonomous selection, score/timing/rhythm resolution, loadout/build execution and skill-resolution adapters over the shared GPR runtime while leaving NPC psychology, AI authority, Character build truth, skill definitions and authored audio with their external owners.
acceptance: Encounter and autonomous selection adapters operate on bounded GPR-local candidate state and explicit owner references without becoming NPC psychology or AI authority.
Score/timing/rhythm resolution uses declared semantic clocks/order and does not make presentation frames or authored audio the source of mechanics truth.
Loadout/build execution consumes explicit Character/Inventory/Progression owner references and cannot replace Character build truth.
Skill-resolution adapters consume accepted skill definitions and explicit owner operations rather than authoring or canonizing skills.
Owner-domain mutation remains receipt-bound; GPR-local encounter, score, loadout or skill outcomes cannot prove canonical mutation.
Unsupported or unavailable encounter/autonomy/score/timing/loadout/skill capabilities fail closed with no generic fallback.
boundaries: GPR-01, GPR-03, GPR-05 and GPR-06 remain predecessors and are not duplicated.
NPC psychology and AI authority remain external; GPR owns only bounded selection/execution adapters.
Character build truth, skill definitions and authored audio remain external owner concerns.
MRCS remains definition authority and later MRCS domains may late-bind.
GPR-08+ composer, delivery, presentation, continuity and final proof remain unauthorized.
MRCS and OARC lane state remain independent.
next_action: On a GPR-specific owner Continue, fresh-read GPR-07, published GPR-01/GPR-03/GPR-05/GPR-06 evidence, the GPR family design closure and ops3-lane-state/gpr, then execute the complete bounded encounter/autonomy/score/timing/loadout/skill tranche.
